# PureClear

> 100% in-browser EXIF/metadata remover. Lossless, no uploads, free forever.

PureClear removes hidden metadata (EXIF, GPS location, XMP, IPTC, document properties) from photos, videos and PDFs entirely in the user's browser. No files are uploaded to any server. Files are processed with ExifTool (WebAssembly) in a Web Worker; PDFs are handled with pdf-lib. Every cleaned file is re-scanned to verify zero tags remain.

- Site: https://pureclear.dusrel.com
- Formats: JPG, PNG, WebP, HEIC, AVIF, GIF, MP4, MOV, PDF
- Locales: English (/), Hindi (/hi), Assamese (/as)
- Contact: pureclear@dusrel.com
- Full site content in one file: https://pureclear.dusrel.com/llms-full.txt

- [Home — the tool](https://pureclear.dusrel.com/): Drop files, inspect their metadata tags, remove them in one click.

- [All formats](https://pureclear.dusrel.com/formats): Every supported format with its own removal guide.
- [About](https://pureclear.dusrel.com/about): Why PureClear exists — your files shouldn't leak your life.
- [Privacy](https://pureclear.dusrel.com/privacy): Zero uploads, zero telemetry policy in plain language.
- [Terms](https://pureclear.dusrel.com/terms): Plain-language terms of service.

## Format guides

- [JPG metadata remover](https://pureclear.dusrel.com/formats/jpg): EXIF, GPS, IPTC and XMP removal from JPEG photos.
- [PNG metadata remover](https://pureclear.dusrel.com/formats/png): Text chunks, eXIf and ancillary metadata removal from PNG images.
- [WebP metadata remover](https://pureclear.dusrel.com/formats/webp): EXIF, XMP and ICC removal from WebP images.
- [HEIC metadata remover](https://pureclear.dusrel.com/formats/heic): EXIF and GPS removal from iPhone HEIC/HEIF photos.
- [AVIF metadata remover](https://pureclear.dusrel.com/formats/avif): EXIF and XMP removal from AVIF images.
- [GIF metadata remover](https://pureclear.dusrel.com/formats/gif): Comment and application metadata removal from GIF files.
- [MP4 metadata remover](https://pureclear.dusrel.com/formats/mp4): Location, device and encoder metadata removal from MP4 video.
- [MOV metadata remover](https://pureclear.dusrel.com/formats/mov): QuickTime location and device metadata removal from MOV video.
- [PDF metadata remover](https://pureclear.dusrel.com/formats/pdf): Document properties, XMP and author metadata removal from PDFs.
